name: Speed garage wobble sub
desc: Sawtooth sub through a sine-wobbled 24db lowpass, syncopated 2-step rhythm walking a G major I-I-vi-IV/V progression, octave-up fill every 8 bars, ply doubles at peak phrase ends. Warehouse pressure.

wob.doc: wobble rate in cycles, bare JS arg

code.full: note("<g1 g1 e1 <c2 d1>>").struct("[x ~ [~ x] ~] [~ x ~ [x ~ ~ x]]").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").ftype('24db').lpf(sine.range(80, ${cut}).fast(${wob})).lpq(8).decay(.3).sustain(.4).shape(.25).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.55, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.1).every(8, x=>x.add(note(12))).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[g1 g2] [g1 g2] [e1 e2] [<c2 c3> <d1 d2>]>").struct("[x [~ x] x [~ x]] [x ~ [x x] [~ x]]").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").ftype('24db').lpf(sine.range(120, ${cut}*1.6).fast(${wob})).lpq(10).decay(.25).sustain(.35).shape(.3).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.5, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.1).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
